evidencePolicyReason: This deployment reaches a CI system, so release evidence must come from one: a summary produced on a laptop is indistinguishable from one typed by hand. An air-gapped deployment of the same product would legitimately declare "local" with that reason instead — EOS forces the decision, it does not make it.
rationale: Hybrid control plane (deterministic, Node) + worker plane (agentic, Python) under a named regulatory regime. `commands.eval` WRITES docs/evidence/eval-summary.json: an eval command that merely exits 0 proves a process ended, not that a threshold was met. `commands.audit` is run by the release gate, where — because complianceProfile is "regulated" — an unrunnable audit BLOCKS instead of being deferred. `evidencePolicy` states how much provenance release evidence must carry — a regulated project must declare it, and "local" is a legitimate answer for an air-gapped environment. The authoritative data-boundary record stays docs/compliance-profile.json.
